qa_pairs.question: What is the main procedure covered in section 41 35 110?
qa_pairs.answer: Replacing the right rear side panel on convertible models.

qa_pairs.question: What reference page should be consulted before beginning this repair?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-001 for information on removing or covering car parts in the repair area.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to protect car parts during this repair procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove or cover up all car parts which are located in the repair area or subjected to heat, sparks and dust.

qa_pairs.question: What is the first step shown in the procedural images for removing spot welds?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover and drill out spot welds as shown in the various locations on the side panel.

qa_pairs.question: What additional welding component needs to be addressed according to image 30 41 655?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove brazing solder and uncover spot welding in the indicated area.

qa_pairs.question: What cutting procedure is shown in image 30 41 658?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover joint and cut off side panel along the indicated line.

qa_pairs.question: What separation step is demonstrated in image 30 41 659?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off side panel from tail panel along the specified line.

qa_pairs.question: What final cutting operation is shown in the bottom image 30 41 070?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off side panel from tail panel and trunk side section.

qa_pairs.question: How many different image references are shown on this page?
What type of joints need to be exposed before cutting in multiple locations?
qa_pairs.answer: Spot welds need to be uncovered and drilled out in various locations on the panel.

qa_pairs.question: What specific welding material needs to be removed according to one of the steps?
qa_pairs.answer: Brazing solder must be removed in addition to uncovering spot welding.

qa_pairs.question: What areas of the vehicle does this side panel connect to that require separation?
qa_pairs.answer: The side panel connects to the tail panel and trunk side section, both requiring separation cuts.
